n: Digital Moment classroom-ready AI and coding lessons
t: Free K-12 lessons on coding and AI, with no coding experience needed.
steps: Find the Digital Moment lesson portal at learn.digitalmoment.org.
Create a free account if you want to save lessons.
Pick one lesson and read its plan.
Check whether the lesson needs micro:bit hardware.
Test the browser tools on a student device.
Run the lesson in about 60 minutes.
